ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) across the central 85% of visible surface area, with high-intensity (white/off-white) regions localized at the distal tips and the trailing edges of the lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white contiguous blobs are mapped to the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. The left lobe tip contains a larger, irregular white cluster extending inward. The right lobe tip shows a smaller, more crescent-shaped white patch. Small, diffuse light-colored spots are scattered across the dark central regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel-calculated vertex angle of 115 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge of both lobes. Peaks and valleys are most pronounced on the distal halves of the lobes, with vertical amplitude variations ranging from approximately 5 to 20 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral upward and outward sweep. The trailing edge follows a complex concave curve from the median notch to the distal tips, punctuated by jagged serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several roughly circular high-contrast (light on dark) pixel clusters are detected. Notable clusters are located in the lower mid-section of the left lobe and the lower-right section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned light-grey linear streaks (scratches) are visible on the dark pigmentation of the right lobe, oriented generally from the leading edge toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, deep irregular indentation or 'chip' is visible on the trailing edge of the right lobe, situated approximately one-quarter of the distance from the median notch toward the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A concentrated white splash pattern is visible at the lower-central base of the fluke where the peduncle meets the water surface.
